notes.title: Three new features have been added to make personality comparisons easier!
notes.content:
In Update Ver: 1.1.0406, three new features have been added to make personality comparisons easier!

[h3][b]Simplified Personality View[/b][/h3]
Previously, the results displayed one page for each personality, but you can now toggle to a simplified view to display all 5 personality types on one screen.
This will make it much easier to take screenshots of your results to share with others!

[h3][b]ID Bookmarks[/b][/h3]
You can now save up to 10 personality test results in your ID bookmarks, which can be opened on the personality comparison screen at any time.

[h3][b]Personality Test Result QR Codes[/b][/h3]
Up till now, personality test results were only searchable by their IDs, which are long strings of numbers and uppercase and lowercase letters.
We have now added the function to create QR codes for easier sharing. Now you won't have to worry about mistyping an ID!

notes.title: New Language Support (French, Italian, German, and Spanish)
notes.content:
We have released a patch (Ver: 1.1.0304) that includes the following updates:
- Added French, Italian, German, and Spanish language support.
- Added "Composite Data" to the personality test results screen. Once you have completed the personality test over 3 playthroughs, you will be able to see the percentages of each of the 23 different personality types that make up your result. This is calculated based on the actions you take during gameplay.

This is calculated based on the actions you take during gameplay.
